name: Guildrun
description:
About This Game

Rifts have torn open in cities across the world, and no one knows what's driving them. You are tasked with building a guild of unique heroes, level them up to crazy power spikes and combine their abilities with items and relics to break the game and unveil the unknown cause of the rift crisis.

Adapt each run as different things are offered to you. With infinite build freedom without a PvP meta that would force certain strategies, every run feels like a new puzzle. As you learn the depth of options available you’ll become an expert at pivoting mid-run, reshaping any makeshift team into an unstoppable force.

Every hero has their starting class and ability, but you choose where they end. With over 500 unique ways to level up and shape each hero, get creative and turn a backline healer into a frontline tank or a ranged dps into a melee brawler. Or, pair two lovers on the battlefield for rapid scaling bonuses.

  • Unlock Heroes, items and relics. Run-by-run, unlock new heroes, relics and items to discover 25 heroes, 180 specializations, 300+ relics and 100+ items in the demo alone.

  • Play on your clock. No timer, no queue, no PvP. Think as long as you want, save mid-run, and come back when life lets you.

  • Break every hero out of their class. 25 heroes across 75 spec paths, and a modifier pool that stacks across classes. Draft, level, respec, and build unfair comps.

  • Progress through 8 difficulties. Every successful run unlocks a harder challenge for the next. Stack fresh modifiers to climb up the difficulty ladder, then hit Endless mode to chase the top of the global leaderboards.

  • Weekly Patches and an active Community. Since we launched the alpha in January of this year, we have been updating and evolving the game every week. Join us along the ride and shape Guildrun with us!
short_desc: Turn a simple team into an unstoppable force and crush waves of monsters in this PvE autobattler roguelike. No two runs feel the same as you bend heroes beyond their class roles and discover countless combinations and synergies. Seal the rifts at your own pace and uncover what tore them open.
